name: Robespierre
source:
A hero who was captured in Valhalla.

As a result of worrying about her motherland and pursuing a world for the masses, she was so covered in sin and blood that she couldn't go back. It seems that she chose to go to another world in search of the path of atonement or punishment greater than death.
